notes.title: 2025-06-06 Update and Add Lang French
notes.notes:
1. The countdown from number 5 has been removed, except for the very first playthrough.
   This allows for faster and smoother gameplay.

2. Game hints have been added during the dice-rolling scene.
   Some in-game information and developer commentary are now shown while rolling the dice.

3. We are excited to announce that this game now supports French!

However, please note that the French translation may not be perfect.
This is due to my unfamiliarity with the language, and also because French tends to require much longer sentences than any other language I’ve supported so far.
Since I was unable to get help from a French expert, I relied on AI assistance and only reviewed the key terms myself.
If you notice any issues, please let me know.

Thank you!

notes.title: 2025-04-01 Added 3 Language and Patch

3. After watching the ending in recollection mode, I modified it to return to immediately not credit schene.

notes.title: 2025-03-21 Recollection Add
notes.notes:
Hello!
We've added a Recollection Mode.

By clicking the dice once, the dice number will increase by 1 each time!
Now you can easily recreate and view any ending you want.

I'm glad I was able to implement this feature just one day after receiving the request.
(Sadly, I couldn't make a gallery that shows pictures... it seems like that would take a lot more time. Hmm...)

Thank you!

notes.title: 🎲 Welcome to Dice Making Ending!
notes.notes:
Hello, everyone!
Welcome to Dice Making Ending!

Dice Making Ending is an easy and fast PC board game.

You can see the ending of the game in less than 30 seconds, like Internet short!
It's free, and there's no advertisement.

It will be distributed free of charge on March 21st.

Please enjoy the game and give us a lot of feedback!

The content cannot be modified, but if you leave your opinion on the discussion bulletin board, we will use it as a reference for your next work.

Please let us know if there are any bugs.

Thank you!
